description: Queensland roads and tracks is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. Queensland Roads and Tracks (QRT) is the Department of Resources’ foundation dataset of roads data. It is a vector (line segment) dataset depicting the approximal centreline location and attributes of roads and tracks across Queensland. It does not replicate a navigable product.The Data Dictionary is published here. Coverage: Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. It offers 4 resource(s) in REST, SHP, TAB, FGDB, KMZ, GPKG, WMS, XML. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
